status: review-only combined aperture-frame and bottom-keel topology candidate; not a production print release

bottom_keel_partition.meaning: The lower shells omit both MANQ008 bottom-center facets and both synthetic closure triangles. Those four surfaces form one removable bottom keel. The cassette owns the shared rear boundary and the keel is relieved from the cassette by the configured service clearance.

acceptance_holds: Every repaired body shell and the bottom keel must contain exactly one closed manifold connected component before export.
Every aperture-frame feature must remain at least the configured recess behind all source exterior planes used to place it.
Body frames and the relieved bottom keel must clear the selected cassette and frozen aluminum, rail, shoe, tool, and adapter-hardware envelopes.
The keel/cassette clearance cut is an ownership proof only; hidden flanges, alignment, fasteners, sealing, drainage, and wiring features remain required.
Glow-panel and eye insertion, landing, retention, and service paths remain blocking validation work.
Exterior renders, a clean-shell deviation audit, and actual support/brim-inclusive slices must pass before any body-shell print.
